narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The highest common factor of seven and twenty one is twenty one, because it is the bigger number!
<bookmark mark='test'/>A common factor must divide both cards. Twenty one divides itself, but it does not divide seven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A factor can never be bigger than the smaller number.
